originalTitle: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
title: Africa's Big Day! New Maps Show Our True Size!
content:
Hello, Super Kids of Africa!

Hi everyone! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, bringing you some super exciting news from our amazing continent, Africa! Get ready to clap your hands and cheer because something really big and wonderful just happened. It's all about maps, and it's about showing the world how truly awesome and HUGE Africa really is!

What Are Maps?

First, let's talk about maps. What are they? Well, maps are like special drawings of our world. They show us where countries, oceans, and continents are. When you look at a map, you can see where your own country is. You can see where your friends live, and even where exciting animals like lions and elephants live! Maps help us learn about our big, beautiful world.

A Map Problem

For a very, very long time, there was a problem with many old maps. These maps made some places look much bigger than they actually are. And sadly, they made our incredible continent, Africa, look much, much smaller than it truly is! Can you imagine? It was like someone drew a picture of a giant elephant but made it look like a tiny mouse! That's not right, is it?

Did You Know?

Did you know that Africa is a continent? A continent is a very, very big piece of land. There are seven continents in the world. Africa is one of the biggest and most wonderful ones!

The Big Club of Countries

There's a very important club in the world called the United Nations. We can call it the UN for short. Imagine a club where leaders from almost all the countries in the world come together to talk and make good decisions. That's what the UN is! They try to make the world a better, fairer place for everyone.

A Big Vote for Africa!

Guess what happened at this big UN club? Something amazing! A country from Africa, called Togo, had a super idea. Togo said, "Hey everyone! We need new maps! Maps that show Africa its true size! Maps that show the world how big and important Africa really is!" And guess what? Many, many countries listened! One hundred and sixty-four countries said, "Yes! We agree! Let's make new maps!" That's a lot of countries saying "yes"! It was a huge vote, like a big cheer for Africa! Only one country voted "no," but almost everyone else voted "yes" for Africa!

Why Were Old Maps Wrong?

It's a little bit tricky, but I'll tell you simply. Our Earth is round, right? Like a big, round ball. But maps are flat, like a piece of paper. It's very hard to make something round perfectly flat without stretching some parts and squishing others. Imagine trying to flatten an orange peel without tearing it! Some parts would get stretched out. That's what happened with old maps. They stretched out places that were far away from the middle of the world. And because Africa is right in the middle, it got squished down and looked smaller. It was a mistake in how the maps were made.

Did You Know?

Did you know that on many old maps, a place called Greenland looks bigger than Africa? But that's not true at all! Africa is actually about FOURTEEN times bigger than Greenland! Wow! That's like saying a small dog is bigger than a big lion! It's not right!

Why is This News So Good?

This news is fantastic for many reasons! **1. Showing Africa's True Size:** Now, maps will show how truly, truly big Africa is. Africa is massive! It's home to 54 different countries! Imagine all those countries, all those different languages, different foods, and different cultures! Africa is rich with so much variety. **2. Learning the Right Way:** When you look at your school maps or globes, they will now be more correct. You will learn the true size of Africa and all the other continents. This helps you understand the world better. It helps you see how important Africa is on the world stage. **3. Feeling Proud:** This news makes us feel super proud of our continent. Africa has amazing deserts, huge rivers like the Nile, tall mountains, and giant rainforests. It has incredible animals like giraffes, zebras, cheetahs, and rhinos! It has bustling cities and peaceful villages. Africa is full of beauty and wonder. Seeing our continent shown correctly on maps makes us feel proud and happy.

What Does This Mean for You?

This means that the next time you see a world map, or when you learn about geography in school, you'll be seeing a map that is more fair and more true. You'll see Africa in all its true glory, showing just how vast and important it is. It's a reminder that Africa is a powerful continent with so much to offer the world. So, let's cheer for new maps! Let's cheer for Togo! And let's cheer for our amazing continent, Africa! Hurray!
summary: The United Nations has voted to adopt new world maps that will finally show Africa its true, very large size, after many old maps made it look too small.
whyMatters: This is important because it helps everyone learn the correct size of Africa, shows how big and special our continent really is, and makes us all feel proud.
